facts.text: I made a huge batch of cupcakes for a party last weekend.
I am looking for inspiration for my next baking project.
I want recommendations for summer-themed desserts.
I have been meaning to try out a fruit tart.
I want a simple recipe for a pastry crust to use for a fruit tart.
I am thinking of using strawberries and blueberries for a tart.
I am not sure what type of glaze to use for strawberries and blueberries.
I will use a powdered sugar glaze.
I want tips on how to arrange strawberries and blueberries on the tart to make it look visually appealing.
I will arrange the strawberries and blueberries in a concentric circle pattern on the tart.
I will vary the sizes of the fruits on the tart.
I will leave some space between the fruits to create a clean look.
I will add fresh mint leaves around the edges of the tart.
I have mint growing in my backyard.
I can easily grab mint sprigs from my backyard.

events.text: Made a huge batch of cupcakes for a party.
Planned to try a fruit tart and asked for a pastry crust recipe.
Planned to use strawberries and blueberries for the tart and asked about glaze.
Chose a powdered sugar glaze for the tart.
Planned a concentric circle fruit arrangement with varied fruit sizes and spacing.
Planned to add fresh mint leaves around the edges of the tart using mint from backyard.
